Description: Staging-only CloudWatch overview for content-free Authority journey telemetry.

StagingLogGroupName.ConstraintDescription: must be the one owned Authority staging runtime log group

AlertTopicArn.ConstraintDescription: must be the existing same-account SNS alert topic ARN

Properties.AlarmDescription: Staging Authority worker completed fewer than one cycle in two of the last three minutes.
At least two staging Ask retrieval failures occurred in five minutes.
